primary_metric: B adaptation NLL AUC over checkpoints 0,1,2,5,10,20,40; lower is faster learning
H1_near_transfer: For d=0.25 and d=0.50 separately, A_B25 has lower paired B AUC than A_nat.
H2_target_specificity: For d=0.25 and d=0.50 separately, A_B25 has lower paired B AUC than A_wrong25.
H3_distance_interaction: Within each seed, mean(A_B25-A_nat) over near distances {0.25,0.50} is lower than mean over far distances {0.75,1.00}.
decision: Report exact sign-flip permutation p over 2^8 sign assignments and sign counts. H1/H2 require negative mean, >=7/8 seeds in predicted direction, and one-sided exact sign-flip p<=0.05. H3 same direction/count/p rule.
secondary: A-post NLL cost, no-curriculum context, checkpoint-specific B NLL deltas.
claim_boundary: Synthetic aligned-state LM mechanism only; not evidence yet that a natural Japanese curriculum improves human English learning.
